$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — ComposeInput. Major version 1. Per-run transport contract from the det core to a native-content compose adapter subprocess (stdin, single JSON document; issue #23 G3). The core has already schema-validated every embedded payload and verified all cross-pins (registry/binding/NodeIR/PageStructure/manifest identity and revisions) BEFORE spawning; the adapter re-validates defensively against the same contracts. Platform-neutral transport: capability ids, appearance ids and content values appear only as data, never as schema vocabulary.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Compose Input (transport)

platformId.description: Must be one of the compose adapter's declared platformIds (checked by core before spawn).

registry.description: The pinned capability registry the composer must ground every native target in.

bindings.description: The pinned binding map (may be empty when the section carries no component instances).

nodeIr.description: The full semantic inventory; document order in childrenNodeIds is the composition order.

pageStructure.description: The editorial-only structural plan; its sections, in order, are the composition units.

content.description: Caller-supplied literal content, pinned to the same source revision.
